tail:
Completed the batch 46 draft items and A/B pages. **18 items are recorded ready; the event driven sphere algorithm is escalated** because T10’s planned page has no item bodies or supplier IDs yet. The unresolved interface is recorded in the [cross batch dependency evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-46.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

The main results include projected dynamics existence, uniqueness, convergence, and an \(O(\sqrt h)\) error bound with certified projection tolerances. I also carried both Countable Choice and Dependent Choice through the results that inherit them from the absolutely continuous FTC supplier.

The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-differential-equations-and-stochastic-dynamics/nonsmooth-contact-time-stepping-and-projections.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-differential-equations-and-stochastic-dynamics/nonsmooth-contact-time-stepping-and-projections-examples.md), [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-46.notes.md), [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-46.coverage.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-46.proof-contracts.json) contain the arguments and evidence. The source record includes Stewart’s book text ([full text copy](https://www.scribd.com/document/1044460955/David-Stewart-Dynamics-With-Inequalities); [SIAM publication record](https://epubs.siam.org/doi/book/10.1137/1.9781611970715)) and Bertsekas’s [MIT lecture notes](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-253-convex-analysis-and-optimization-spring-2012/6c63c6219c60378bc27d5b4a9167f1bc_MIT6_253S12_lec_comp.pdf). Two failed mirror URLs have documented resolutions; the replacement sources passed fetch checks.

Scoped checks passed: author check, precheck, proof layout (19 items, 45 steps), rendercheck, dependency checks, coverage checklist, and strict proof contracts. The run wide dependency check still reports 86 empty inventories outside this batch. The run wide Step 1 check could not load because of malformed YAML titles in the other pair’s [adaptive Simpson algorithm](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/alg-certified-adaptive-simpson.md:24) and [enclosure theorem](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-certified-adaptive-simpson-enclosure.md:28); I left those files untouched.
